text: 9月6日，中国进出口银行宣布，财政部将向中国进出口银行注资300亿元，有效巩固进出口银行资本根基、厚植可持续发展底气，显著提升服务实体经济与对外开放的资金供给能力和风险防控韧性，为更好履行政策性金融职责使命、服务国家重大战略筑牢坚实保障。（新华社）
text_en: On Sept 6, the Export-Import Bank of China announced that the Ministry of Finance will inject 30 billion yuan into the bank, effectively consolidating its capital base and strengthening sustainable development fundamentals, significantly enhancing its capacity for funding supply to serve the real economy and opening-up, as well as its risk prevention resilience, laying a solid foundation for better fulfilling policy finance missions and serving major national strategies. (Xinhua)
